The '''repulsor fist''', also known as a '''repulse-hand''' or an '''enforcer grip''', was a type of [[durasteel]] [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] weapon. It contained miniature [[Repulsorlift generator|repulsor generators]] that could be switched on to deliver crushing blows and deflect incoming attacks, and was usually not covered in [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] because it was not intended to appear natural.<ref name="LoNH" />
